judged_text: lib/tasks/disqus.thor:148 — Blocking P1, confidence 100: `post = TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])` expands an XML export migration into mandatory live article retrieval through `open(url).read`, so a Disqus export containing a deleted article returning HTTP 404 aborts the entire import before its comments are migrated, although the previous permalink-based creation imported that same export without accessing the source website; embed URL enhancements do not justify removing migration support for archived or unavailable sites.

adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that the diff changes lib/tasks/disqus.thor from using PostCreator.new with a permalink to using TopicEmbed.import_remote. Looking at the diff for TopicEmbed.import_remote (in app/models/topic_embed.rb), it calls `open(url).read` which will make an HTTP request to fetch the remote content. This means if the URL returns a 404 or is unavailable, the import will fail. The previous code created posts with just a permalink reference without fetching remote content. This is a real behavioral change that could break imports of Disqus exports where source articles are no longer available.
